corrections: Independent dialog ownership no longer follows the lifetime of a removed opener or a separately mounted menu that opened it. Anchored-popup defaults remain unchanged.
Reopening during exit clears content inertness. Mode changes avoid rebinding a detached opener and preserve the resolved theme.
After-close callbacks run after focus restoration. An opener removed during the opening request falls back to connected focus or the dialog scope.
A supplied theme source is a complete root scope, so an undefined theme name does not inherit an unrelated named theme. Public CSS token values preserve local overrides.

focus-trap documents Safari keyboard-preference limits and delegates intermediate Tab moves. Its public key hooks now yield to one shared modal traversal owner using maintained tabbable discovery. Native date/time segments retain their own traversal, with navigation completed at their observed focus boundary. Prevented editor keys remain owned by the editor.
Theme generation supports valid grouped default/light selectors instead of rejecting normalized source CSS. The failing generator regression now passes.
The token manifest count now includes acme-drawer-size. Retired implementation tests are replaced with the new native contracts rather than retained as compatibility coverage.
limits: Actual Safari, OS input and assistive-technology timing remain M22/M26, including native date/time focus boundaries.
Generated React wrappers and scoped-registry/adoption acceptance remain M22.
M17 still contains Tooltip, Hover Card and Toggle Tip. This record does not close the whole batch.
M15 Command Menu is next and must compose the public Dialog/Input/Scroll Area instead of keeping its separate overlay engine.
Transitive imported-helper fingerprints remain an explicit M25/E03 correction with M26 release verification.
